Rural dialysis network (build).name: Rural dialysis network (build)
Rural dialysis network (build).description: This is a model of the rural dialysis network. "waiting list" is a stock measured in patients, starting at 40; it is increased by "referrals" and "returning" and decreased by "treatments started" and "patients giving up". "chairs" is a stock measured in chairs, starting at 20; it is increased by "chairs arriving". "chairs on order" is a stock measured in chairs, starting at 0; it is increased by "ordering chairs" and decreased by "chairs arriving". "discouraged patients" is a stock measured in patients, starting at 0; it is increased by "patients giving up" and decreased by "returning". "referrals" (a flow) equals "base referrals". "treatments started" (a flow) equals MIN("waiting list" / "minimum wait", "chairs" * "patients per chair"). "patients giving up" (a flow) equals "waiting list" * "give up fraction". "returning" (a flow) equals "discouraged patients" / "time to return". "ordering chairs" (a flow) equals MAX(0, ("desired chairs" - "chairs" - "chairs on order") / "order adjustment time"). "chairs arriving" (a flow) equals "chairs on order" / "build delay". "base referrals" is 36 patients/month. "minimum wait" is 1 months. "patients per chair" is 1.2 patients/(chair*month). "give up fraction" is 0.05 1/month. "time to return" is 14 months. "target wait" is 2 months. "desired chairs" equals "waiting list" / "target wait" / "patients per chair". "order adjustment time" is 3 months. "build delay" is 9 months. Simulate from months 0 to 48 in steps of 0.125.

City bike-share membership (build).name: City bike-share membership (build)
City bike-share membership (build).description: This is a model of the city bike-share membership. "potential members" is a stock measured in people, starting at 49900; it is decreased by "signing up". "members" is a stock measured in people, starting at 100; it is increased by "signing up". "signing up" (a flow) equals "potential members" * "advertising effect" + "word of mouth". "advertising effect" is 0.0005 1/month. "word of mouth" equals "contact rate" * "members" * "potential members" / "total population" * "persuasion". "total population" equals "potential members" + "members". "contact rate" is 10 1/month. "persuasion" is 0.025 dimensionless. Simulate from months 0 to 36 in steps of 0.0625.

Regional distributor inventory (build).name: Regional distributor inventory (build)
Regional distributor inventory (build).description: This is a model of the regional distributor inventory. "inventory" is a stock measured in cases, starting at 400; it is increased by "deliveries" and decreased by "shipments". "supply line" is a stock measured in cases, starting at 600; it is increased by "orders" and decreased by "deliveries". "expected demand" is a stock measured in cases/week, starting at 100; it is increased by "updating expectations". "shipments" (a flow) equals "demand". "deliveries" (a flow) equals "supply line" / "delivery delay". "orders" (a flow) equals MAX(0, "expected demand" + ("desired inventory" - "inventory") / "adjustment time" + "supply line weight" * ("desired supply line" - "supply line") / "adjustment time"). "updating expectations" (a flow) equals ("demand" - "expected demand") / "expectation time". "demand" equals "base demand" + STEP("demand increase", "step time"). "base demand" is 100 cases/week. "demand increase" is 20 cases/week. "step time" is 4 weeks. "delivery delay" is 6 weeks. "desired inventory" equals "expected demand" * "coverage". "coverage" is 4 weeks. "adjustment time" is 2 weeks. "desired supply line" equals "expected demand" * "delivery delay". "supply line weight" is 0 dimensionless. "expectation time" is 4 weeks. Simulate from weeks 0 to 60 in steps of 0.0625.

Coffee-growing cooperative (build).name: Coffee-growing cooperative (build)
Coffee-growing cooperative (build).description: This is a model of the coffee-growing cooperative. "planted area" is a stock measured in hectares, starting at 300; it is increased by "planting". "soil fertility" is a stock measured in points, starting at 95; it is increased by "soil recovery" and decreased by "soil depletion". "planting" (a flow) equals "harvest" * "coffee price" * "reinvestment share" / "cost per new hectare". "soil depletion" (a flow) equals "planted area" * "soil fertility" * "depletion per hectare". "soil recovery" (a flow) equals ("healthy soil score" - "soil fertility") / "soil recovery time". "harvest" equals "planted area" * "yield per hectare". "yield per hectare" equals "best yield" * "fertility effect" * "labor effect". "fertility effect" equals ("soil fertility" / "healthy soil score") ^ "fertility sensitivity". "hectares per family" equals "planted area" / "member families". "labor effect" equals 1 / (1 + ("hectares per family" / "hectares a family can tend") ^ "labor sensitivity"). "best yield" is 1.2 tonnes/(hectare*year). "coffee price" is 3000 dollars/tonne. "reinvestment share" is 0.5 dimensionless. "cost per new hectare" is 6000 dollars/hectare. "depletion per hectare" is 0.0001 1/(hectare*year). "healthy soil score" is 100 points. "soil recovery time" is 15 years. "fertility sensitivity" is 2 dimensionless. "member families" is 600 families. "hectares a family can tend" is 10 hectares/family. "labor sensitivity" is 4 dimensionless. Simulate from years 0 to 15 in steps of 0.0625.

Kitchen fitting backlog (build).name: Kitchen fitting backlog (build)
Kitchen fitting backlog (build).description: This is a model of the kitchen fitting backlog. "job backlog" is a stock measured in jobs, starting at 44.05; it is increased by "new orders" and "callbacks" and decreased by "jobs fitted" and "cancellations". "hidden faults" is a stock measured in jobs, starting at 13.22; it is increased by "faulty fits" and decreased by "callbacks". "fitting crews" is a stock measured in crews, starting at 11.02; it is increased by "hiring". "new orders" (a flow) equals "base orders" + STEP("surge size", "surge start") - STEP("surge size", "surge end"). "jobs fitted" (a flow) equals MIN("desired fitting", "capacity" * "work intensity"). "cancellations" (a flow) equals "job backlog" * "cancel fraction". "faulty fits" (a flow) equals "jobs fitted" * "error rate". "callbacks" (a flow) equals "hidden faults" / "discovery time". "hiring" (a flow) equals MAX(0, ("desired crews" - "fitting crews") / "hiring time"). "base orders" is 10 jobs/week. "surge size" is 7 jobs/week. "surge start" is 4 weeks. "surge end" is 24 weeks. "target lead time" is 4 weeks. "desired fitting" equals "job backlog" / "target lead time". "jobs per crew" is 1 jobs/(crews*week). "capacity" equals "fitting crews" * "jobs per crew". "schedule pressure" equals "desired fitting" / "capacity". "maximum rush" is 1.4 dimensionless. "work intensity" equals MIN("maximum rush", MAX(1, "schedule pressure")). "normal error fraction" is 0.1 dimensionless. "rush error effect" is 10 dimensionless. "error rate" equals "normal error fraction" * (1 + "rush error effect" * ("work intensity" - 1)). "discovery time" is 12 weeks. "cancel fraction" is 0.002 1/week. "desired crews" equals "desired fitting" / "jobs per crew". "hiring time" is 30 weeks. Simulate from weeks 0 to 78 in steps of 0.125.

Regional specialty mushroom growers (bui.name: Regional specialty mushroom growers (build)
Regional specialty mushroom growers (bui.description: This is a model of the regional specialty mushroom growers. "growing rooms" is a stock measured in rooms, starting at 100; it is increased by "rooms coming into production" and decreased by "rooms closed" and "rooms worn out". "rooms under construction" is a stock measured in rooms, starting at 0; it is increased by "new rooms started" and "rooms reopened" and decreased by "rooms built". "rooms starting up" is a stock measured in rooms, starting at 0; it is increased by "rooms built" and decreased by "rooms coming into production". "idle rooms" is a stock measured in rooms, starting at 0; it is increased by "rooms closed" and decreased by "rooms reopened" and "idle rooms scrapped". "new rooms started" (a flow) equals "growing rooms" * "building response" * "profit per kilo" / "growing cost". "rooms built" (a flow) equals "rooms under construction" / "construction time". "rooms coming into production" (a flow) equals "rooms starting up" / "start up time". "rooms closed" (a flow) equals "growing rooms" * "closing response" * "loss per kilo" / "growing cost". "rooms worn out" (a flow) equals "growing rooms" / "room lifetime". "rooms reopened" (a flow) equals "idle rooms" * "reopening response" * "profit per kilo" / "growing cost". "idle rooms scrapped" (a flow) equals "idle rooms" / "time to scrap". "production" equals "growing rooms" * "yield per room". "price" equals "reference price" * ("reference demand" / "production") ^ "price sensitivity". "profit per kilo" equals MAX(0, "price" - "growing cost"). "loss per kilo" equals MAX(0, "growing cost" - "price"). "monthly losses" equals "production" * "loss per kilo". "reference demand" is 240000 kg/month. "reference price" is 6 dollars/kg. "price sensitivity" is 2 dimensionless. "yield per room" is 2000 kg/(room*month). "growing cost" is 5 dollars/kg. "building response" is 0.8 1/month. "construction time" is 6 months. "start up time" is 3 months. "closing response" is 0.15 1/month. "room lifetime" is 36 months. "reopening response" is 0.1 1/month. "time to scrap" is 4 months. Simulate from months 0 to 72 in steps of 0.125.

Regional ambulance service (build).name: Regional ambulance service (build)
Regional ambulance service (build).description: This is a model of the regional ambulance service. "population" is a stock measured in people, starting at 400000; it is increased by "population growth". "crews" is a stock measured in crews, starting at "calls handled" / "calls per crew"; it is increased by "crews starting". "crews awaiting budget" is a stock measured in crews, starting at 0; it is increased by "crews requested" and decreased by "crews starting". "response time target" is a stock measured in minutes, starting at "normal response time"; it is increased by "relaxing the target". "population growth" (a flow) equals "population" * "growth rate". "crews requested" (a flow) equals MAX(0, "crews needed" - "crews" - "crews awaiting budget") / "review time". "crews starting" (a flow) equals "crews awaiting budget" / "budget delay". "relaxing the target" (a flow) equals MAX(0, "performance gap") / "target adjustment time". "calls" equals "population" * "calls per resident". "calls handled" equals "calls" * (1 - "neighbor share"). "crew capacity" equals "crews" * "calls per crew". "workload" equals "calls handled" / "crew capacity". "response time" equals "normal response time" * "workload". "performance gap" equals "response time" - "response time target". "crews needed" equals IF "response time target" > 0 THEN "crews" * (1 + "performance gap" / "response time target") ELSE "crews". "growth rate" is 0.006 1/month. "calls per resident" is 0.005 calls/(person*month). "neighbor share" is 0.05 dimensionless. "calls per crew" is 95 calls/(crew*month). "normal response time" is 10 minutes. "review time" is 3 months. "budget delay" is 12 months. "target adjustment time" is 12 months. Simulate from months 0 to 120 in steps of 0.125.

Parcel delivery van fleet (build).name: Parcel delivery van fleet (build)
Parcel delivery van fleet (build).description: This is a model of the parcel delivery van fleet. "vans" is a stock measured in vans, starting at 200; it is increased by "buying vans" and decreased by "retiring vans". "fleet miles" is a stock measured in miles, starting at 18000000; it is increased by "miles driven" and decreased by "miles retired". "buying vans" (a flow) equals MAX(0, MIN("vans wanted", "vans affordable")). "retiring vans" (a flow) equals MIN("vans due for retirement", "buying vans" + MAX(0, "vans" - "vans needed") / "fleet adjustment time"). "miles driven" (a flow) equals "vans" * "miles per van". "miles retired" (a flow) equals "retiring vans" * "average mileage". "average mileage" equals ZIDZ("fleet miles", "vans"). "miles per van" is 15000 miles/(van*year). "vans due for retirement" equals "vans" / "van life". "van life" is 6 years. "vans wanted" equals "vans due for retirement" + ("vans needed" - "vans") / "fleet adjustment time". "fleet adjustment time" is 1 years. "vans needed" equals "parcel demand" / "parcels per van". "parcel demand" is 2000000 parcels/year. "parcels per van" is 10000 parcels/(van*year). "vans affordable" equals "money for vans" / "van price". "van price" is 40000 dollars/van. "money for vans" equals MAX(0, "van budget" - "repair share" * "repair costs"). "van budget" equals "base van budget" * (1 - STEP("budget cut", "cut year")). "base van budget" is 2600000 dollars/year. "budget cut" is 0.15 dimensionless. "cut year" is 2 years. "repair share" is 1 dimensionless. "repair costs" equals "breakdowns" * "cost per breakdown". "cost per breakdown" is 2500 dollars/breakdown. "breakdowns" equals "vans" * "breakdowns per van". "breakdowns per van" equals "normal breakdown rate" * ("average mileage" / "normal mileage") ^ 2. "normal breakdown rate" is 2 breakdowns/(van*year). "normal mileage" is 90000 miles/van. Simulate from years 0 to 10 in steps of 0.0625.

Community food bank volunteers (build).name: Community food bank volunteers (build)
Community food bank volunteers (build).description: This is a model of the community food bank volunteers. "volunteers" is a stock measured in volunteers, starting at 40; it is increased by "recruiting" and decreased by "quitting". "fatigue" is a stock measured in dimensionless, starting at 1; it is increased by "tiring". "Potential Volunteers" is a stock measured in volunteers, starting at 210; it is increased by "quitting" and decreased by "recruiting". "families served" is a stock measured in families, starting at 200; it is increased by "new families" and decreased by "families moving on". "Families Not Yet Reached" is a stock measured in families, starting at 1000; it is increased by "families moving on" and decreased by "new families". "recruiting" (a flow) equals "friends joining" + "recruitment fairs". "quitting" (a flow) equals "volunteers" * "normal quit fraction" * "fatigue". "tiring" (a flow) equals ("stress" - "fatigue") / "fatigue time". "new families" (a flow) equals "agency referrals" + "family word of mouth". "families moving on" (a flow) equals "families served" / "time on rolls". "friends joining" equals "volunteers" * "friend recruiting rate" * "untapped share". "untapped share" equals "Potential Volunteers" / "willing people". "willing people" equals "Potential Volunteers" + "volunteers". "friend recruiting rate" is 0.12 1/month. "recruitment fairs" is 0.25 volunteers/month. "normal quit fraction" is 0.06 1/month. "workload" equals "families served" / MAX("volunteers", 1). "manageable load" is 5 families/volunteer. "stress" equals "workload" / "manageable load". "fatigue time" is 6 months. "agency referrals" is 4 families/month. "family word of mouth" equals "families served" * "word of mouth fraction" * "unreached share". "unreached share" equals "Families Not Yet Reached" / "families in need". "word of mouth fraction" is 0.15 1/month. "families in need" equals "Families Not Yet Reached" + "families served". "time on rolls" is 20 months. Simulate from months 0 to 36 in steps of 0.0625.

Regional electricians' guild (build).name: Regional electricians' guild (build)
Regional electricians' guild (build).description: This is a model of the regional electricians' guild. "Normal Work" is a stock measured in jobs/month, starting at 3300; it is increased by "work growth". "apprentices" is a stock measured in people, starting at 96; it is increased by "taking on apprentices" and decreased by "qualifying". "journeymen" is a stock measured in people, starting at 192; it is increased by "qualifying" and decreased by "becoming masters". "masters" is a stock measured in people, starting at 360; it is increased by "becoming masters" and decreased by "retiring". "work growth" (a flow) equals "Normal Work" * "work growth rate". "taking on apprentices" (a flow) equals MIN("intake wanted", MIN("places opening up", "college places")). "qualifying" (a flow) equals "apprentices" / "apprenticeship time". "becoming masters" (a flow) equals "journeymen" / "time as journeyman". "retiring" (a flow) equals "masters" / "time as master". "work growth rate" is 0.002 1/month. "slow spell" equals STEP("slump depth", "slump start") - STEP("slump depth", "slump end"). "slump depth" is 0.2 dimensionless. "slump start" is 24 months. "slump end" is 48 months. "jobs requested" equals "Normal Work" * (1 - "slow spell"). "qualified electricians" equals "journeymen" + "masters". "work capacity" equals "qualified electricians" * "most jobs per electrician". "most jobs per electrician" is 6.6 jobs/(person*month). "jobs turned away" equals MAX(0, "jobs requested" - "work capacity"). "normal jobs per electrician" is 6 jobs/(person*month). "electricians wanted" equals "jobs requested" / "normal jobs per electrician". "workforce gap" equals "electricians wanted" - "qualified electricians". "intake wanted" equals MAX("minimum intake", "retiring" + "workforce gap" / "intake adjustment time"). "minimum intake" is 0 people/month. "intake adjustment time" is 24 months. "apprentice places" equals "masters" * "apprentices per master". "apprentices per master" is 0.6 dimensionless. "places opening up" equals "apprentice places" / "apprenticeship time". "college places" is 30 people/month. "apprenticeship time" is 48 months. "time as journeyman" is 96 months. "time as master" is 180 months. Simulate from months 0 to 144 in steps of 0.125.

Hospital contract cleaning standard (bui.name: Hospital contract cleaning standard (build)
Hospital contract cleaning standard (bui.description: This is a model of the hospital contract cleaning standard. "cleaning staff" is a stock measured in cleaners, starting at 49; it is increased by "cleaners starting" and decreased by "cleaners leaving". "open positions" is a stock measured in cleaners, starting at "cleaning staff" / "average stay" * "hiring time"; it is increased by "cleaners requested" and decreased by "cleaners starting". "inspection standard" is a stock measured in dimensionless, starting at 0.9; it is decreased by "lowering the standard". "cleaners requested" (a flow) equals MAX(0, "cleaners leaving" + ("cleaners needed" + "cleaners leaving" * "hiring time" - "cleaning staff" - "open positions") / "review time"). "cleaners starting" (a flow) equals "open positions" / "hiring time". "cleaners leaving" (a flow) equals "cleaning staff" / "average stay". "lowering the standard" (a flow) equals MAX(0, "shortfall") / "revision time". "shortfall" equals "inspection standard" - "pass rate". "cleaners needed" equals "cleaning staff" * (1 + ZIDZ("shortfall", "pass rate")). "cleaning hours" equals "cleaning staff" * "hours per cleaner" + "porter hours". "hours per room" equals ZIDZ("cleaning hours", "rooms"). "share of rooms failing" equals "reference failing share" ^ ("hours per room" / "reference hours per room"). "pass rate" equals 1 - "share of rooms failing". "rooms" equals "original rooms" + STEP("new wing rooms", "wing opening"). "original rooms" is 400 rooms. "new wing rooms" is 200 rooms. "wing opening" is 24 months. "hours per cleaner" is 160 hours/(cleaner*month). "porter hours" is 160 hours/month. "reference failing share" is 0.1 dimensionless. "reference hours per room" is 20 hours/(room*month). "average stay" is 24 months. "hiring time" is 4 months. "review time" is 3 months. "revision time" is 12 months. Simulate from months 0 to 96 in steps of 0.125.

Valley groundwater board (build).name: Valley groundwater board (build)
Valley groundwater board (build).description: This is a model of the valley groundwater board. "groundwater" is a stock measured in acre-feet, starting at 700000; it is increased by "recharge" and decreased by "town pumping" and "farm pumping" and "golf course pumping". "town population" is a stock measured in people, starting at 20000; it is increased by "population growth". "orchard acreage" is a stock measured in acres, starting at 8000; it is increased by "planting" and decreased by "orchards pulled out". "recharge" (a flow) equals "rain recharge" + "recharge scheme". "town pumping" (a flow) equals "town demand" * "town well yield" * "pumping allowed share". "farm pumping" (a flow) equals "farm demand" * "farm well yield" * "pumping allowed share". "golf course pumping" (a flow) equals "golf course use". "population growth" (a flow) equals "town population" * "town growth rate". "planting" (a flow) equals "orchard acreage" * "planting rate" * MAX(0, "orchard profit margin"). "orchards pulled out" (a flow) equals "orchard acreage" * "pull out rate" * MAX(0, -"orchard profit margin"). "rain recharge" is 26500 acre-feet/year. "recharge scheme" is 0 acre-feet/year. "golf course use" is 300 acre-feet/year. "aquifer base depth" is 400 feet. "storage per foot" is 2000 acre-feet/foot. "depth to water" equals "aquifer base depth" - "groundwater" / "storage per foot". "town well depth" is 200 feet. "farm well depth" is 200 feet. "town water column" equals "town well depth" - "depth to water". "farm water column" equals "farm well depth" - "depth to water". "town well yield" equals "town water column". "farm well yield" equals "farm water column". "water use per person" is 0.2 acre-feet/(person*year). "town demand" equals "town population" * "water use per person". "water per acre" is 3 acre-feet/(acre*year). "farm demand" equals "orchard acreage" * "water per acre". "pumping wanted" equals "town demand" * "town well yield" + "farm demand" * "farm well yield". "basin pumping cap" is 1000000000 acre-feet/year. "pumping allowed share" equals MIN(1, "basin pumping cap" / MAX("pumping wanted", 1)). "town shortfall" equals "town demand" - "town pumping". "irrigation met" equals "farm well yield" * "pumping allowed share". "full crop value" is 3000 dollars/(acre*year). "crop value per acre" equals "full crop value" * "irrigation met". "growing cost" is 1700 dollars/(acre*year). "lift cost" is 2.5 dollars/(acre-foot*foot). "pumping cost" equals "lift cost" * "depth to water" * "water per acre" * "irrigation met". "orchard profit" equals "crop value per acre" - "growing cost" - "pumping cost". "orchard profit margin" equals "orchard profit" / "full crop value". "planting rate" is 0.3 1/year. "pull out rate" is 0.3 1/year. "town growth rate" is 0.03 1/year. Simulate from years 0 to 20 in steps of 0.0625.
